5.24
Security Features
The Intelligent Research Assistant implements multiple security mechanisms.
• Password Hashing using bcrypt
• JWT Authentication
• Session Management
• Protected API Routes
• Input Validation using Pydantic
• CORS Configuration
These security measures protect user accounts and prevent unauthorized access to
research data.
